name: PR-Agent
description: AI pull request reviewer that writes reviews, improvement suggestions and answers for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea.
whatItDoes: PR-Agent inspects a pull request and produces a structured review, concrete code suggestions or answers to questions about the change. Teams run it from a CLI, as a GitHub Action, or as a webhook service. It is now maintained by its community.
howItWorks: Each command such as review, improve or ask maps to one focused LLM call. A compression strategy fits large diffs into the context window. Models are accessed through LiteLLM and results are posted back through the git provider's API.

requirements.name: OPENAI_KEY
requirements.description: Model key used in the documented quick start

requirements.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
requirements.description: Token for the GitHub Action to comment on pull requests

models: OpenAI by default; other providers through LiteLLM
